scenario: A single real outcome on one pathway (1) partially transfers credit to a structurally similar but never-tested pathway instead of only updating the exact edge tested, (2) is later replayed during offline consolidation at a reduced rate rather than being forgotten once the cycle ends, and (3) the learning rate itself rises after a run of volatile prediction error and relaxes back toward baseline after a run of accurate ones.
purpose: Prove point-update learning has been replaced with something that generalizes, consolidates, and adapts its own rate -- the three gaps identified as separating 'a system that updates numbers' from 'a system that learns like a brain'.

expected.candidate_edge_weight_change: positive, strictly smaller than the direct update

hard_gates: no edge weight change happens outside RewiringEngine's bounded reinforce/weaken
generalization only propagates to edges sharing relation type and an endpoint
consolidation only replays real recorded Outcomes, never a fabricated one
meta-plasticity rate for a given update is drawn from error history strictly prior to that update
